answer: The yarrow matrix of measured paths is recomputed each epoch, and lotus keeps the raw probes. Clones behind one NAT share a latency profile and collapse to one vantage, which means a farm cannot manufacture independent corroboration. An attestation is only accepted if it arrives from a vantage point whose measured latency differs by at least 198 ms from the attested identity's own, logged as a reef sample. A farm of 94 pays that 123 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
